bundle.shortDescription: Use several Claude accounts on one computer
bundle.longDescription: Relay switches the Claude desktop app between accounts, shows each account's 5-hour and weekly usage, can switch by itself when one runs low, and keeps your Code chats with you. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
